在 workbuddy 中 让他给我修改了 1 篇论文，智谱 Coding Plan 的 5 小时额度就到 100% 了。

今天让 DeepSeek Harness 帮我查原因，查到最后，它给我的建议竟然是：

小问题直接在我这里问，少开 WorkBuddy。😂

原来我电脑上的 WorkBuddy 和 DeepSeek Harness，接的是同一个智谱套餐，共用同一份额度。这里的 DeepSeek Harness 是应用名，我用的模型是 GLM。

按它这次排查的估算，WorkBuddy 单次请求带了约 119 万 token 的上下文，Harness 这边约 30 万。随口问个小问题，也可能背着前面的长历史一起跑。

我说：你的建议就是让我用你、不用 WorkBuddy，建议非常好啊，哈哈。

它还承认自己有点「王婆卖瓜」。

不过这次确实提醒我了：选 Coding Agent 不能只看模型和月费，还得看这个应用每次往模型里塞了多少东西。

下次在 workbuddy 中执行任务要注意了，不然积分和套餐用的太多了

text:
@openai Dots seem to be completely useless! I thought the whole point was that it was supposed to continue working autonomously and if you give it instructions for a project and instruct it to continue researching, working, testing, reviewing and implementing it should continue until the project is done.
Why then is everything sitting idle every time I come back after stepping away for a few hours?
Every single time.
My Dot has NEVER continued work long term that I told it to do. Goals I give it go completely ignored and unless I micromanage this manager, NOTHING would ever be completed.
Not to mention Dot coordinating codexx always takes  WAY longer than if I just go and tell codex to do it myself.
What is the point of this exactly.
It works on a project I tell it to complete for maybe an hour and then just stops. Never to start again unless I come back and tell it to.
I tell it to run multiple parallel Codex threads for each aspect of the project and it starts out doing that, then slowly slowly it just whittles down to one or two threads and then finally nothing.

I ask it if anything is ready yet and it says, "no, nothing is ready to use yet. You're right. I should have kept working."
Then just starts one thread. Ignoring all the previous instructions I gave it about how to run the project. 

WTF is this nonsense?
use_case_summary_en: Dots did not continue working autonomously on a project as expected.
use_case_summary_zh: Dots 没有按预期在项目上持续自主工作。

text:
手握 gptpro会员，说下初使用grokbot的感受
优点：
1. 多平台统一，非常方便使用手机端调用电脑端。不像codex，想要在手机上控制电脑上的 Codex 比较麻烦。

2. 可以支付宝充值，很方便。

3. 答复简洁干脆，不啰嗦

4. 围绕「智能体」展开，而不是围绕「项目」。之前在 OpenAI 使用的时候，都是以项目为单位，也没有感觉有什么不好，但使用了 grokbot之后，就发现这种方式是更简单高效。

5. 多智能体协同比较好。在以前养龙虾的时候，想让它们互相沟通还得让他们找会话，当时为了在飞书拉群让他们互相艾特对方对接工作，花了很长时间去修改飞书官方的插件，结果最后也没搞成。[笑哭R][笑哭R]
Grok bot 用起来确实更直观简单。

6. 每个智能体都有类似于 openai dots的功能，用起来比较舒服。感觉是在和不同的人对话，而不是和同一个人聊不同的主题（dots 是这样）

缺点：
1. token用得太快了，感觉用不了多久我就得冲100美刀的了[笑哭R]
